label: coverage_pypi_downloads_per_day
query: SELECT project, min(date) AS first_day, max(date) AS last_day FROM pypi.pypi_downloads_per_day WHERE project IN ('aiobotocore','aiohttp','annotated-types','anyio','boto3','botocore','certifi','cffi','charset-normalizer','click','cryptography','filelock','fsspec','grpcio-status','idna','litellm','numpy','packaging','pandas','pathspec','platformdirs','protobuf','pydantic','pydantic-core','pygments','pyjwt','pytest','python-dotenv','requests','rpds-py','s3transfer','starlette','tqdm','typing-extensions','typing-inspection','urllib3','uvicorn') AND date >= '2025-09-01' GROUP BY project ORDER BY project
